questions: Should the heatmap have annotations (annot=True) as shown in the reference solution, or is the default (no annotations) acceptable?
Should the correlation matrix be computed using Pearson correlation (default) or a different method (e.g., Spearman)?
Is the heatmap expected to be returned as a matplotlib Axes object (as seaborn.heatmap returns) or should it be a figure or some other representation?
Should the function set any specific heatmap parameters like colormap, figure size, or title?
If the input contains exactly one row (single sublist), correlation matrix is undefined (NaN). Should the function still return a heatmap of NaNs, raise an error, or handle it differently?
Are the column names strictly 'A' through 'E' in that order, or should they be assigned based on the order of sublist elements?
Should the function validate that all sublists have length exactly 5, or is any fixed length acceptable as long as they match?
If non-numeric data is provided, should the ValueError message match a specific string, or is any ValueError acceptable?
